article.title: Tulsa visits Navy in AAC matchup
article.linkText: Tulsa visits Navy in AAC matchup
article.story: Tulsa (3-2) at Navy (1-3), Oct. 10 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Navy by 2.5. Against the spread: Navy 0-4, Tulsa 3-2. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats Navy Offense Overall: 380.5 yards per game (83rd in FBS) Passing: 103.8 yards per game (134th) Rushing: 276.8 yards per game (5th) Scoring: 25.3 points per game (92nd) Navy Defense Overall: 308.5 yards per game (35th in FBS) Passing: 212.3 yards per game (76th) Rushing: 96.3 yards per game (21st) Scoring: 22.8 points per game (62nd) Tulsa Offense Overall: 354.2 yards per game (100th in FBS) Passing: 180.8 yards per game (111th) Rushing: 173.4 yards per game (55th) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (76th) Tulsa Defense Overall: 405.4 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 272.2 yards per game (132nd) Rushing: 133.2 yards per game (62nd) Scoring: 21.2 points per game (52nd) Navy is 128th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 47.2% of third downs. Navy ranks 92nd in the FBS with a -2 turnover margin, compared to Tulsa's 9th-ranked +6 margin. Navy is 24th in the FBS averaging 45 penalty yards per game. Tulsa ranks 113th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76.9% of trips. Tulsa is 126th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:20, compared to Navy's 52nd-ranked average of 31:05. Team leaders Navy Passing: Jackson Gutierrez, 344 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 43.6 completion percentage Rushing: Braxton Woodson, 299 yards on 38 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Truman Brasfield, 107 yards on 2 catches, 1 TD Tulsa Passing: Baylor Hayes, 564 yards, 4 TDs, 1 INT, 60.4 completion percentage Rushing: Damari Alston, 292 yards on 68 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Oran Singleton, 306 yards on 26 catches, 2 TDs Last game Navy fell 14-9 to Air Force on Oct. 3. Gutierrez threw for 140 yards on 7-of-15 attempts (46.7%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 12 times for 33 yards. Michael Barrow carried the ball nine times for 44 yards, adding one reception for four yards. Brasfield put up 68 yards on one catch with one touchdown. Tulsa was beaten by North Texas 45-44 on Oct. 1. Hayes led Tulsa with 211 yards on 25-of-43 passing (58.1%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball five times for 14 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Alston had 79 rushing yards on 23 carries and one touchdown, adding four receptions for 22 yards. Singleton put up 104 yards on 11 catches. Next game Navy plays at UTSA on Oct. 17. Tulsa plays at Rice on Oct. 17.
